name: ballerinax/mssql
description: This module provides the functionality required to access and manipulate data stored in an MSSQL database. It enables seamless integration with Microsoft SQL Server, supporting various data types and advanced database features.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Connects to a MSSQL database with the specified configuration.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: MSSQL server hostname

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Database username (if secured)

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password (if secured)

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Database name to connect to (optional)

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: MSSQL server port

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: MSSQL server instance name (optional)

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Advanced connection options (optional)

parameters.name: connectionPool
parameters.description: Connection pool for connection reuse. If not provided, the global connection pool (shared by all clients) will be used

functions.name: query
functions.description: Executes a SQL query and returns multiple results as a stream.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: SQL query with optional parameters (e.g., `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=${userId}`)

parameters.name: rowType
parameters.description: Record type to map query results to

return.description: Stream of records containing the query results. Please ensure that the stream is fully consumed, or close the stream.

functions.name: queryRow
functions.description:
Executes a SQL query that is expected to return a single row or value as the result.
If the query returns no results, `sql:NoRowsError` is returned.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query (e.g., `` `SELECT * FROM Album WHERE name=${albumName}` ``)

parameters.name: returnType
parameters.description:
The `typedesc` of the record to which the result should be mapped.
It can be a basic type if the query result contains only one column

return.description: Result in the `returnType` type or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: execute
functions.description: Executes a SQL query and returns execution metadata (not the actual query results).

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: SQL query with parameters (e.g., `` `DELETE FROM Album WHERE artist=${artistName}` ``)

return.description: Execution metadata as an `sql:ExecutionResult`, or an `sql:Error` if execution fails

functions.name: batchExecute
functions.description:
Executes multiple SQL commands in a single batch operation, and returns execution metadata (not the actual query results).
If one command fails (except due to a syntax error), execution continues for the remaining commands and
the `sql:BatchExecuteError` will be returned at the end with details of all errors.

parameters.name: sqlQueries
parameters.description: Array of SQL queries with parameters

return.description: Array of execution results or an `sql:Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: call
functions.description:
Calls a stored procedure with the given SQL query.
Once the results are processed, invoke the `close` method on the `sql:ProcedureCallResult`.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: SQL query to call the procedure (e.g., `` `CALL sp_GetAlbums()` ``)

parameters.name: rowTypes
parameters.description: `typedesc` array of the records to which the results should be mapped

return.description: Summary of the execution and results as `sql:ProcedureCallResult`, or an `sql:Error` if the call fails

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the MSSQL client and shuts down the connection pool.
The client should be closed only at the end of the application lifetime, or when performing graceful stops in a service.
